# Third-party vendor marks

Third-party names and logos are trademarks of their respective owners and are
used only to identify the corresponding service. Original copyright licenses,
notices and vendor conditions remain applicable. These files are not covered by
the ModelPlan official-visual license. No supplied mark was redrawn, recoloured,
normalized or given a new outline in the resource files. SHA-256 hashes are in
the adjacent resource manifest.

- `openai.svg`: original white blossom from the [OpenAI Cookbook brand assets](https://github.com/openai/openai-cookbook/blob/4a85c3018d20ceef48bf7549450c567896501bf9/examples/voice_solutions/realtime_translation_guide/livekit-translation-demo/public/brand/chatgpt-blossom-white.svg), commit `4a85c3018d20ceef48bf7549450c567896501bf9`. [Brand guidance](https://openai.com/brand/).
- `claude.svg`: the unchanged Claude Spark Clay SVG from the [Anthropic press kit](https://www.anthropic.com/press-kit), supplied colour `#D97757`.
- `cursor.svg`: original `CUBE_2D_DARK.svg` from the archive linked by [Cursor brand guidelines](https://cursor.com/brand), retaining its supplied `#EDECEC` white variant.
- `copilot.svg`: original `Copilot_Icon_White.svg` from the [GitHub logo archive](https://brand.github.com/GitHub_Logos.zip). [Copilot identity guidance](https://brand.github.com/brand-identity/copilot).
- `grok.svg`: the two mark paths of the logo inlined on [grok.com](https://grok.com/), paths unchanged and without the wordmark, drawn in white as the site does on dark. Only the `viewBox` and the fill value are added, because the page sets the fill with `currentColor`. xAI trademark. Its `favicon.svg` uses `foreignObject`, which the widget's SVG decoder rejects, and Simple Icons has no Grok icon.
- `antigravity.png`: the logo served by [antigravity.google](https://antigravity.google/) (`/assets/image/antigravity-logo.png`), unmodified. Google trademark.
- `droid.png`: the avatar of the [Factory-AI GitHub organization](https://github.com/Factory-AI), the maker of Droid, unmodified. Factory trademark.
- `gemini.svg`, `qwen.svg`, `minimax.svg`, `deepseek.svg`, `x.svg` and `xiaomi.svg`: the prototype's vector set (`public/brands`), single-path SVGs generated from [Simple Icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons) (CC0-1.0 for the collection), using each icon's path and brand hex. These are single-colour Simple Icons renderings, not the vendors' own files, so a multi-colour mark such as Gemini's appears in one colour. The marks remain their owners' trademarks. Paths and colours are unchanged. Only the `viewBox` is fitted to the glyph (optical box), except `xiaomi.svg`, which is app-icon artwork. `x.svg` is the white variant.
- `zhipu.svg` (Z.ai / 智谱): the prototype's app-icon artwork from `public/brands`, unmodified, used for Zhipu, GLM and Z.ai. Displayed with the owner's permission: the maintainer confirmed on 2026-10-04 that the authorization required by the [Z.ai Terms of Use](https://chat.z.ai/legal-agreement/terms-of-service), section V.2, has been obtained. Remove the mark if the permission is withdrawn.
- `amp.svg`: original `logo-dark.svg` from the [Amp press kit](https://ampcode.com/press-kit/), unmodified.
- `kiro.svg`: the vector site icon served by [kiro.dev](https://kiro.dev/) (`/icon.svg`), unmodified. Kiro trademark.
- `kimi.svg`: original [K-only dark-background SVG](https://moonshotai.github.io/Branding-Guide/scenarios/04-k-only/k-only-dark.svg), white with its original blue accent, from [Moonshot's branding guide](https://moonshotai.github.io/Branding-Guide/).
- `opencode.svg`: unchanged `logoDarkSvg` download from the [OpenCode brand page](https://opencode.ai/brand), retaining both supplied colours.
- `zai-white.svg`: the existing website white Z mark, without a background, recolouring or additional outline. Maintainer-authorized for beta identification only; its inclusion requires a new decision before public release. Vendor permission records remain with the maintainer. [Z.ai terms](https://chat.z.ai/legal-agreement/terms-of-service).
